name: asdd-pipeline
description: Side panel with the ASDD pipeline and the project's spec status

specsDir.title: specs/ directory
specsDir.description: Absolute path to the project's specs/ directory (e.g. /home/user/my-project/specs). If left empty, the plugin uses relative paths (specs/ and asdd_tools/) against the directory you launched Claude Code in, so you normally don't need to set it and it works per project. Set it only if your specs/ is not at the project root.

panelUrl.title: Full panel URL
panelUrl.description: URL of the ASDD web dashboard (e.g. http://localhost:8777/asdd_tools/index.html). If left empty, the plugin uses the URL recorded by serve-panel.mjs when it serves the panel (asdd_tools/.panel-url), falling back to the default Node port (8777).
